body.statement: In the unrestricted fixed-population problem on \(2J\) units with potential outcomes in a known bounded interval, minimization over all assignment laws and all measurable estimators is attained by independent \(\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) assignment together with the nonlinear Bayes rule generated by a least-favourable endpoint prior. In particular, for binary outcomes this procedure attains \(r^{\mathrm U}_{2J}\).

attestation.note: Verified against the theorem and proof location in arXiv:2608.09812v3; the node records only the binary fixed-population specialization used here.
